items.note: The prompt opens with the decision: keep Postgres with pgvector or adopt a dedicated vector database.
It lists about 5M embeddings at 1536 dimensions, growing about 1M per quarter.
It gives Postgres 16 on AWS RDS as the current setup.
It sets the budget under $500/month and asks for cost to be checked against it.
It says every query must filter by tenant_id (multi-tenant).
It caps the comparison at 4 options, with pgvector counting as one.
It asks for a comparison table plus one clear recommendation.
It says to prefer sources from the last 12 months and to flag older ones.
It asks for a wide scan first, then a deep dive on the top 2.
